prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one production concept sheet for an original Minecraft Bedrock neighborhood post office prop set, dark forest green, ivory, muted brass, warm kraft cardboard. Crisp voxel models and pixel-level detail, manufacturable with boxes and simple bevels, neutral light warm gray studio, good contrast, equal visual weight across objects. Very wide cohesive sheet, organized into three horizontal bands with crisp whitespace and small English labels. Top band: POSTAL COUNTER, the same 3-block wide, 1-block deep, 1-block high freestanding counter from front 3/4 and rear 3/4, ivory transaction ledge, forest-green front with simple cream envelope pictogram, visible worker-side drawers and open knee space. Next to it SORTING CUBBIES, the same 2-block wide, 1-block deep, 2-block high open shelf shown front 3/4 and rear 3/4, twelve distinct compartments (4 columns by 3 rows), a few envelopes and postal trays, closed cabinet back with service hardware. Middle band: PARCEL LOCKERS, the same three-block wide, one-block deep, two-block high cabinet shown from front and rear, different green and cream locker doors, visible seams and numbered labels, one small central screen, full rear casing with seams and vents. Next to it MAILBOX, standalone one-block wide and deep, one-block high green cast-metal post box with horizontal mail slot, cream envelope emblem, rounded stepped shoulders, rear pickup door. Bottom band: POSTAL SCALE, standalone tabletop small digital parcel scale with metal weighing platform and separate low numeric display with two keys; next to it exactly THREE distinct closed brown cardboard parcels side by side, small flat square, medium cube, large wide rectangular, each visibly different size and proportion, with packing tape, thin shipping label and print marks. Every object separated by whitespace, no attached tools or furniture except their described integral parts, no humans, no ceiling or room background, no real-world brands. Labels only as described, no numeric dimension text in the image, leave space around every prop. Emphasize physically connected geometry, realistic compartment and hinge placement, no unintentional holes.
